manualFollowUps: Pages: merging publishes sat-playbook. Every SAT Playbook function call now adds ?forceFunctionRegion=ap-southeast-1 so the Edge Function runs next to the Singapore database instead of at the learner's nearest edge (eu-central-1 for Uzbekistan). Override with VITE_SUPABASE_FUNCTION_REGION if the database ever moves. No function or database change.
verification: In the browser network tab on playbook.sat.schood.online, sat-playbook requests carry forceFunctionRegion=ap-southeast-1 and responses have x-sb-edge-region: ap-southeast-1.
Median first-byte for a public module page drops from about 1.96 s to about 1.2 s (measured 18 loads each before the change).
